population: 13 eligible frozen questions in the original 20-paper cohort
method: Descriptive recoding of documented first-pass retrieval quality and directness. No new future-label adjudication and no claim that a search failure proves a research question unresolved.

retrieval_evidence_classes.primary_full_text_checked: A dated future primary full text was inspected at least in the relevant sections; may still miss the exact question.
retrieval_evidence_classes.abstract_or_search_visible_only: A candidate has at most an abstract/search-visible passage; exact test conditions cannot be authenticated.
retrieval_evidence_classes.undated_web_only: A relevant web page exists but first-public date and matched primary result are not authenticated.
retrieval_evidence_classes.source_or_pre_cutoff_only: Only the source or older prior art is in the ledger; not a future outcome.
retrieval_evidence_classes.no_candidate_primary: Bounded searches located no candidate future primary source. This does not establish absence.

explanations.inadequate_retrieval: Supported as a measurement limitation: 9/13 lack a checked future primary full text. This does not prove a direct result exists.
explanations.excessively_narrow_formulations: Plausible and directly documented in all four full-text near-misses: exact graph/marking/security-conjunction/FD-table conditions fail. Do not loosen the original rubric after seeing these hits.
explanations.genuine_absence_of_direct_research: Not identified: non-detection cannot distinguish absence from retrieval failure.
explanations.insufficient_outcome_window: Not identified in this audit: no matched later result is authenticated just beyond a frozen three-year window. The new, separate pilot uses a prespecified five-year window to test this prospectively.
explanations.source_selection_bias: Observed source-screen attrition was 7/20; source-only title filtering in the new pilot yielded 1 eligible and 1 ineligible in its first two section screens. Too small to estimate improvement or scientific prevalence.
explanations.nonobservable_resolution_criteria: Not a total absence: all 13 old eligible questions specify a falsification gate, but empirical gates often demand an exact comparator and multiple endpoints. The full-text near-misses demonstrate low match probability, not a license to relabel.
explanations.partial_progress_vs_resolution: Directly evidenced by near-miss types (e.g., unmarked cycles and component security constructions), but dimensional trajectory labels require independent primary-source and date checks under the new rubric. This audit does not assign such labels retrospectively.

scientific_decision: Stop treating repeated keyword variation on these 13 as the highest-value next action. Preserve their unadjudicated direct labels; build a separate source-only observable cohort and capture evidence dimensions without converting topical near-misses into resolution.
uncertainty: This is a 13-question descriptive diagnostic of one bounded search pass. Retrieval depth differs among rows, and the new cohort's title filter has unknown selection bias.
